01ESTEstablished · 9+ years

Fiber Network Design

OSP and FTTH layouts for aerial and underground builds, drawn to the client's standard and ready for the next team in line.

Capabilities

  • Aerial and underground fiber layouts, conduit routes and access points
  • Survey data, imagery, GIS data and markups turned into clean CAD drawings
  • Network features in 3GIS and QGIS: routes, structures, splices, drops
02ESTEstablished

Design Quality Control

A careful second review before drawings go out: details checked, inconsistencies traced, findings the design team can act on quickly.

Capabilities

  • Technical review of layouts and drawing sets, including ride-out QC
  • Drawing accuracy checked against client drafting standards
  • Mapping data validated against imagery and field data; clear redlines
03ESTEstablished

Technical Documentation

Drawings and records that hold up after the project moves on. The map behind this section turns into a CAD sheet.

Capabilities

  • Construction and permit drawing sets, as-built documentation
  • Rights-of-way and existing infrastructure, to NCDOT standards where they apply
  • Bills of materials and quantities (BOM / BOQ), organized CAD files
04ESTEstablished · the bridge

Project Systems

Trackers and spreadsheets that show where every job stands. Clean, consistent records are what any later automation reads.

Capabilities

  • Project tracking for design jobs; status, counts and deliverables
  • Process documentation and checklists
  • Consistent naming and status fields, readable by people now and tools later

Practice project · P-01

Appointment-booking availability check

Hands-on practice prototype · in development. The booking module on this site asks an n8n workflow whether a requested period is free on my calendar before a request can be sent.

Prototype · in development

Verified on this site

  • Form payload → webhook → fields → calendar read → IF → respond
  • Whole requested period checked, not just the start time
  • Unverified, busy and failed checks never shown as available
  • Request sent by email with an .ics file, marked pending
  • Weekends, PH holidays and the Philippine night-shift window handled on the page

In development

  • Auto-confirmation for regular hours (calendar write, server-side re-check)
  • Request log to a sheet and a drafted reply
  • Assistant that drafts the confirmation email for review

Sheet 06 · About

About

I design fiber networks, check them carefully and keep the records clean. The same discipline now goes into AI, automation and smarter workflows.

For nine-plus years I've designed OSP/FTTH fiber networks remotely for U.S. telecom teams: layouts, drawing sets, QC and the records that go with them. The work rewards people who follow the standard, notice small inconsistencies and leave a clear trail.

That discipline is now going into a second specialty. I'm learning to connect the tools small teams already use and to let AI assistants draft what a person then checks, practising on real problems like the booking check on this site. Developing, and labelled as such.

View my résumé ↗Start a Conversation
